title: Eyes for an Eagle
description: Eagle hunter Rinat Mirlanov rests with his golden eagle above the Bokonbayevo village in Kyrgyzstan. Eagle hunting, known as berkutchi in Kyrgyz, is an ancient tradition in the country where hunters train golden eagles to hunt small prey like foxes and hares. The practice requires years of trust and reliance built between the eagle and the hunter. Although eagle hunting today is considered more of a hobby, it was originally used as a means of survival, providing both food and clothing to villagers.
translated_description: 在吉尔吉斯斯坦博孔巴耶沃村上空，猎鹰人里纳特·米尔拉诺夫与他的金雕一同休憩。猎鹰活动在当地语言中被称为"别尔库特奇"，是该国一项古老传统——猎人们训练金雕捕捉狐狸、野兔等小型猎物。这项技艺需要猎人与金雕之间历经多年建立信任与依赖。尽管如今猎鹰更多被视为一种爱好，但其最初是作为生存手段，为村民提供食物与衣物。
